reviews.x: This product is excellent! I recently took it on vacation to a tropical island.  After swimming, I had no time for makeup before heading out, so I put a small amount on cheeks and on nose...blended well... and a bit on lips.  It gave me an island glow to enhance my tan.  Very natural looking and makes you look healthy.  So small, it travels very easy.  Gives you the flushed, no makeup look, that many celebrities use at a fraction of the cost.

I'm a minimalist when it comes to make up, and keep it really natural.  I mostly only use coverup, brow stuff, & lip stuff, & now this little stick has become one of my favorite things!  It's small, which is perfect to bring anywhere.  Especially when I travel, It's the perfect quick little blush, lip tint, warm-up on my brow bones & forehead.  People complain about the size, but its so pigmented that I barely need to touch it on my skin to leave a tiny smear that I just blend in with my fingert

love love love! This is my favorite blush ever and I'm a makeup junkie. The first time I bought this blush it last me years I felt I needed to re-stock my holy grail product but by the time I looked for it again it was discontinued so I was ecstatic to find it online for such a perfect price. The seller took great care in packaging the product and I am very happy.

I know this product to be safe, non-toxic and have no serious ingredient concerns. However, after I purchased, I saw that the ingredients listed under the description had carcinogens, so I worried I'd be receiving an old formulation of the face stick that had all these toxic ingredients. Thankfully, I received the new formulation with no Red-40 or parabens, which were a part of the old formulation. This is the best, most natural looking blush I have ever found.  I have searched for YEARS to try to find a natural looking blush.  I bought one of these and then held onto it for several months; not really trying it.  Then one day I tried it and boom!  Perfect peaches and cream complexion.  I'll always continue to use this for blush.

I love the color. The product is small so be aware that there isn't much product to begin with. I have fairly lighter skin and the pink lemonade color just doesn't work for my skin. The product applies easily and does have many potential uses. I will probably be using this for my lips, but definitely not my cheeks.

I have had bad luck with cream blush before so I wanted to try something in expensive that is easy to apply.  I bought this in the pink lemonade because it looked to be universal shade.  I have only tried this product on my cheeks and it turned them really shiny, almost too fake and shiny that it was too noticeable.  My skin can get a little oily to begin with so that didn't help my cause.  It started to wear off before I even got past ten a.m. in my work day.  It didn't blend into my skin well

reviews.t: I used to buy it for 1$ and I just love it. I am fair in complexion
reviews.x: They discontinued this. I used to buy it for 1$ and I just love it. I am fair in complexion . Blonde hair. Its fine for lips and cheeks and looks so natural. Elf please keep making this product. I have given a few as gifts seems to do well on anyone.

reviews.t: Very nice color stick (SMALL but nice)
reviews.x: I really like this color stick. The pink lemonade is so pretty and leaves just a little shimmer on your skin. For me it lasted a day on my face so that was good. The package is small but still good for the price. I'm happy with this purchase.

reviews.t: LOVE THIS and Will be ordering again!
reviews.x: Nice color. I was worried pink lemonade would be to light but on my cheeks it's perfect! I love it on my lips too and it even out lasts some lip stains I have!

This is a pretty color but I bought this blush based on the ingredients shown in the picture on the back of the package which have a low toxic rating. HOWEVER the product I received has a different ingredient list that includes BHA which according to the Skin Deep website is a Human endocrine disruptor - strong evidence. As well as petrolatum classified as expected to be toxic or harmful  This also has proplyparaben a Human immune toxicant or allergen - strong evidence.  So I'm not sure I should

I bought this product for the first time several—maybe 4—years ago.  I didn't wear it often, so it has literally lasted that long.  I just received a new one, only to find it reformulated with the addition of glittery sparkle.  Cute on a six-year-old playing dress-up or a twenty-something out for a night on the town, but unnecessary and ruinous in a product for a broader market, especially that of grown women who want to be taken seriously. reviews.t: Very nice product. I like the color
reviews.x: Very nice product. I like the color. While it appears pinker than you'd probably like, I find that when you rub it in (as with most things like this), the color smooths out and winds up looking quite natural. It also provides a light, natural sheen of sorts, which is quite nice.  The only thing I didn't care for was that the picture seemed a little deceiving, as the tube is much smaller than I expected.  :)  It won't last long, that's for sure. But while it does, I will most definitely enjoy it!

I have these in several colors. I consistently use a skin-tone color (Ivory, I believe) as an under eye concealer and Pink Lemonade as a cream blush. They work well and last much longer than I expected based on their size. 5 stars =)

The e.l.f. all over color stick is one of my favorites in my makeup bag. It makes for a nice blush and/or a pretty lip color. I have an ivory skin tone that tends to dry out and this stuff adds a natural, dewy flush.
Love the product! The color is perfect for my use and easy to apply. However instead of 5 stars I gave it 3 since it's over priced only 2.00 at Walmart.
i love this cover stick the price is amazing and it helps cover up my dark circles and you can use it as an eyeshadow or you can use it as a blush.
Terrible. It has a terrible chemical smell and a chalky feeling, hard to apply. Lucky it was only a dollar wasted.

reviews.t: For an inexpensive color stick it's not too bad
reviews.x: I actually really like these. They don't add a whole lot of color but they do give a certain glowing hue. They are a little too "shimmery" for my liking but for night time or for Summer when you have a little color the shimmer isn't all that noticeable. You can feel it on your cheek and where you apply it feels kinda tight but not nothing you can't live with. Do I feel like I wasted money on these; no. would I purchase again; hmm probably not. I like powder blushes better but for how cheap they

I like the product but it is tiny!  It wasn't expensive but I didn't have any idea it was such a little container and even smaller amount of blush. It's not good to use as a stick, you need to use your finger or sponge applicate because it has a rim on it. Instead of being flat, or raised int he middle it's concave. You end up with hard areas if you try to use the applicator.

Bought this product early in Nov.  Tried it because if was inexpensive and I love to try different cosmetics.  It's now 4 months later and, after using this almost everyday (if I don't bring a purse I carry it in a pocket) on my lips and as a blush , I am running out.  Love this little treasure.

For an inexpensive cream blush, this product is good deal. It's a flattering shade and it smells good. It is a little stiff so I dab it on my cheeks and spread it with makeup sponge--using a moisturizer first makes it blend much easier. For the money, it's a great buy.

The best color stick I've tried!!! This doesn't make my face itch the way a well-known, all-natural one did. Plus, it's long lasting; looks fantastic; and gives me a great glow! So easy to use too! Travels well! Great price!!

reviews.t: Weight not as stated in the ad. Love the product..
reviews.x: Not quite sure what happened.. but what I received was actually 0.14 oz / 4.0 gram instead of 0.8 Oz.See picture. I have used this blush for a couple years and it works perfect on my skin as it blends evenly.
I  paid  $5 for a dab of hard chalky stuff.i was stupid enough to buy 2 of them . both  going in trash. One was not as chalky so they could be old product.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product for giving a natural-looking flush and glow, often using it on both cheeks and lips.
Many reviewers find it versatile and multi-purpose, using it as blush, lip color, and even under-eye concealer.
Several reviewers note the product is small, though some consider it good value for the price.
Some reviewers raise concerns about ingredients, including carcinogens or toxins in the formulation they received.
A few reviewers report issues with the color or finish, such as the shade not working for their skin or looking too shiny.
